# Moul UI

> Moul UI (`@moul-dev/ui`, v2026.10.16) is an accessible, standards-first Web Components library built with Lit, Shadow DOM, and native CSS tokens (OKLCH + `light-dark()`). Components are framework-agnostic `<moul-*>` custom elements.

<!-- Generated by `bun run sync:llms --write` from ui/dist/custom-elements.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

## Quick Start

```bash
bun add @moul-dev/ui
# or
npm install @moul-dev/ui
```

```js
// Registers every <moul-*> custom element (side-effect import).
import '@moul-dev/ui'
// CSS token layer: colors, spacing, radii, typography, motion.
import '@moul-dev/ui/style.css'
```

Without a bundler:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@moul-dev/ui/dist/assets/style.css" />
<script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@moul-dev/ui/dist/moul-ui.js"></script>
```

## Core Rules for LLMs & AI Coding Agents

- **Imports**: `import '@moul-dev/ui'` once registers every `<moul-*>` element. Import design tokens with `import '@moul-dev/ui/style.css'`. There is no `@moul-dev/ui/react`, `@moul-dev/ui/tokens`, or `@moul-dev/ui/tokens.stylex` entry point.
- **Markup, not JSX components**: Write native custom element tags (`<moul-button>`), never PascalCase components (`<Button>`). They work in plain HTML, Astro, Lit, Vue, Svelte, and React 19.
- **Attributes are kebab-case**: Boolean state uses presence attributes such as `is-disabled`, `is-open`, `is-checked`, `is-required`. The matching JS property is camelCase (`el.isDisabled = true`).
- **Rich data is set as properties**: Arrays, objects, and functions (`data`, `series`, `columns`, `items`, `logs`, `valueFormatter`) are assigned in JavaScript, not serialized into attributes.
- **Events are DOM events**: Listen with `addEventListener` (`press`, `change`, `input`, `openchange`, `selectionchange`, `pagechange`, `dismiss`). Payloads live on `event.detail`. There is no `onPress` prop.
- **Overlays**: Toggle `is-open` (or `el.isOpen`) on `<moul-modal>`, `<moul-drawer>`, `<moul-alert-dialog>`, `<moul-popover>`, `<moul-tooltip>`, `<moul-command-palette>`, and react to `openchange` (`detail.isOpen`).
- **Forms**: Inputs are form-associated via `ElementInternals`; give each a `name` and it submits with a native `<form>` / `FormData`.
- **Semantic tones & variants**: `tone` is one of `primary | accent | success | warning | error`; surface `variant` is one of `solid | flat | shadow | bordered | glass`. `<moul-button>` has its own `variant` set (`primary | secondary | tertiary | outline | ghost | danger | danger-soft`).
- **Accessibility**: Icon-only buttons (`is-icon`) and dot badges (`is-dot`) must have an `aria-label`.
- **Theming**: Override `--brand-hue`, `--brand-chroma-multiplier`, `--brand-radius-factor`, and `--brand-density-factor` on `:root` (or any ancestor). Style internals through `::part(...)`.

## Context Files

- [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt): Complete attribute, property, event, slot, and CSS part reference for every element.
- [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md): Agent rules, recipes, and anti-patterns.
- [Theme inspector](/theme): Live brand token playground.

## Component Index

### Charts & Data Visualization

- [AreaChart](/docs/components/charts/areachart): D3-powered area chart with optional stacking, grid lines, and hover tooltips. Elements: `<moul-area-chart>`.

```html
<moul-area-chart id="revenue" x-key="month" height="280" stacked></moul-area-chart>
```

```js
const chart = document.querySelector('#revenue')
chart.data = [
  { month: 'Jan', web: 120, mobile: 80 },
  { month: 'Feb', web: 160, mobile: 95 },
]
chart.series = [
  { key: 'web', name: 'Web' },
  { key: 'mobile', name: 'Mobile' },
]
```

- [BarChart](/docs/components/charts/barchart): Vertical or horizontal bar chart with grouped or stacked series. Elements: `<moul-bar-chart>`.

```html
<moul-bar-chart id="signups" x-key="day" layout="vertical" show-grid></moul-bar-chart>
```

```js
const chart = document.querySelector('#signups')
chart.data = [{ day: 'Mon', count: 12 }, { day: 'Tue', count: 18 }]
chart.series = [{ key: 'count', name: 'Sign-ups' }]
```

- [LineChart](/docs/components/charts/linechart): Multi-series line chart with configurable D3 curve. Elements: `<moul-line-chart>`.

```html
<moul-line-chart id="latency" x-key="time" curve="monotoneX"></moul-line-chart>
```

```js
const chart = document.querySelector('#latency')
chart.data = [{ time: '10:00', p50: 42, p99: 180 }, { time: '10:05', p50: 39, p99: 150 }]
chart.series = [{ key: 'p50', name: 'p50' }, { key: 'p99', name: 'p99' }]
chart.valueFormatter = (v) => `${v} ms`
```

- [DoughnutChart](/docs/components/charts/doughnutchart): Doughnut / pie chart with a centered label and sublabel slot. Elements: `<moul-doughnut-chart>`.

```html
<moul-doughnut-chart id="traffic" center-label="12.4k" center-sublabel="Visits"></moul-doughnut-chart>
```

```js
document.querySelector('#traffic').data = [
  { name: 'Direct', value: 5400 },
  { name: 'Search', value: 4100 },
  { name: 'Social', value: 2900 },
]
```

- [TopList](/docs/components/charts/toplist): Ranked list with proportional value bars. Elements: `<moul-top-list>`.

```html
<moul-top-list id="pages" max-items="5" show-rank interactive></moul-top-list>
```

```js
document.querySelector('#pages').data = [
  { label: '/pricing', value: 1820 },
  { label: '/docs', value: 1240 },
]
```

- [Stat](/docs/components/stat): KPI tile with animated value, trend indicator, and optional sparkline. Elements: `<moul-stat>`.

```html
<moul-stat label="Monthly revenue" value="48210" prefix="$" trend="up" trend-value="+12.5%" tone="success"></moul-stat>
```

- [Percentage](/docs/components/charts/percentage): Linear and circular percentage indicators. Elements: `<moul-percentage-bar>`, `<moul-percentage-circle>`.

```html
<moul-percentage-bar value="72" label="Storage used" tone="warning"></moul-percentage-bar>
<moul-percentage-circle value="64" size="lg" label="Uptime"></moul-percentage-circle>
```

- [ChartContainer](/docs/components/charts/areachart): Responsive chart frame with title, description, legend, and empty state slots. Elements: `<moul-chart-container>`.

```html
<moul-chart-container title="Revenue" description="Last 30 days" height="320">
  <moul-area-chart x-key="month"></moul-area-chart>
  <span slot="empty">No data yet</span>
</moul-chart-container>
```

- [ChartTooltip](/docs/components/charts/areachart): Floating tooltip used internally by charts; usable standalone for custom SVG. Elements: `<moul-chart-tooltip>`.

```html
<moul-chart-tooltip label="Jan" value="$1,200" x="120" y="40" is-open></moul-chart-tooltip>
```

### Actions & Toggles

- [Button](/docs/components/button): Button with 7 variants, 3 sizes, icon-only mode, and pending state. Elements: `<moul-button>`.

```html
<moul-button variant="primary" size="md">Save changes</moul-button>
<moul-button variant="ghost" is-icon aria-label="Close">×</moul-button>
<moul-button variant="danger" is-pending>Deleting…</moul-button>
```

- [ButtonGroup](/docs/components/buttongroup): Groups buttons with attached or spaced layouts. Elements: `<moul-button-group>`.

```html
<moul-button-group spacing="none">
  <moul-button variant="outline">Day</moul-button>
  <moul-button variant="outline">Week</moul-button>
</moul-button-group>
```

- [ToggleButton](/docs/components/togglebutton): Two-state button that reflects `aria-pressed`. Elements: `<moul-toggle-button>`.

```html
<moul-toggle-button value="bold" aria-label="Bold">B</moul-toggle-button>
```

- [ToggleButtonGroup](/docs/components/togglebuttongroup): Single-select toggle group with roving tabindex keyboard navigation. Elements: `<moul-toggle-button-group>`.

```html
<moul-toggle-button-group selected-key="left" aria-label="Alignment">
  <moul-toggle-button value="left">Left</moul-toggle-button>
  <moul-toggle-button value="center">Center</moul-toggle-button>
  <moul-toggle-button value="right">Right</moul-toggle-button>
</moul-toggle-button-group>
```

### Inputs & Forms

- [TextField](/docs/components/textfield): Form-associated text input with label, description, and error message. Elements: `<moul-text-field>`.

```html
<moul-text-field name="email" type="email" label="Email" placeholder="you@example.com" is-required></moul-text-field>
```

- [NumberField](/docs/components/numberfield): Numeric input with stepper buttons and min/max bounds. Elements: `<moul-number-field>`.

```html
<moul-number-field name="seats" label="Seats" value="5" min="1" max="50" step="1"></moul-number-field>
```

- [SearchField](/docs/components/searchfield): Search input in a `<search>` landmark with a clear button. Elements: `<moul-search-field>`.

```html
<moul-search-field name="q" label="Search" placeholder="Search projects…"></moul-search-field>
```

- [TextArea](/docs/components/textarea): Multiline text input with optional content-based auto-resize. Elements: `<moul-text-area>`.

```html
<moul-text-area name="bio" label="Bio" rows="4" auto-resize></moul-text-area>
```

- [Checkbox](/docs/components/checkbox): Form-associated checkbox with indeterminate state. Elements: `<moul-checkbox>`.

```html
<moul-checkbox name="terms" is-required>I accept the terms</moul-checkbox>
```

- [CheckboxGroup](/docs/components/checkboxgroup): Group of checkboxes submitting an array value. Elements: `<moul-checkbox-group>`.

```html
<moul-checkbox-group name="notify" label="Notify me by" orientation="horizontal">
  <moul-checkbox value="email">Email</moul-checkbox>
  <moul-checkbox value="sms">SMS</moul-checkbox>
</moul-checkbox-group>
```

- [RadioGroup](/docs/components/radiogroup): Radio group with arrow-key navigation. Elements: `<moul-radio-group>`, `<moul-radio>`.

```html
<moul-radio-group name="plan" label="Plan" value="pro">
  <moul-radio value="free">Free</moul-radio>
  <moul-radio value="pro">Pro</moul-radio>
</moul-radio-group>
```

- [Switch](/docs/components/switch): On/off switch with `role="switch"` semantics. Elements: `<moul-switch>`.

```html
<moul-switch name="notifications" is-checked>Enable notifications</moul-switch>
```

- [Slider](/docs/components/slider): Range slider with live output. Elements: `<moul-slider>`.

```html
<moul-slider name="volume" label="Volume" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="40"></moul-slider>
```

- [Select](/docs/components/select): Single-select dropdown rendered in a native popover. Elements: `<moul-select>`, `<moul-select-item>`.

```html
<moul-select name="region" label="Region" placeholder="Choose a region">
  <moul-select-item key="us">United States</moul-select-item>
  <moul-select-item key="kh">Cambodia</moul-select-item>
</moul-select>
```

- [ComboBox](/docs/components/combobox): Filterable autocomplete input. Elements: `<moul-combobox>`, `<moul-combobox-item>`.

```html
<moul-combobox name="framework" label="Framework" placeholder="Type to filter…">
  <moul-combobox-item key="astro">Astro</moul-combobox-item>
  <moul-combobox-item key="lit">Lit</moul-combobox-item>
  <span slot="empty">No matches</span>
</moul-combobox>
```

- [DatePicker](/docs/components/datepicker): ISO date input that opens a calendar popover; locale-aware display. Elements: `<moul-date-picker>`.

```html
<moul-date-picker name="start" label="Start date" value="2026-10-19" locale="km-KH"></moul-date-picker>
```

- [Calendar](/docs/components/calendar): Month grid date selector with min/max bounds. Elements: `<moul-calendar>`.

```html
<moul-calendar value="2026-10-19" min-date="2026-01-01" max-date="2026-12-31"></moul-calendar>
```

- [InputOTP](/docs/components/inputotp): One-time passcode input with per-character slots. Elements: `<moul-input-otp>`.

```html
<moul-input-otp name="code" length="6" label="Verification code"></moul-input-otp>
```

- [Form](/docs/components/form): Native `<form>` wrapper that collects values from form-associated `moul-*` fields. Elements: `<moul-form>`.

```html
<moul-form action="/api/signup" method="post">
  <moul-text-field name="email" type="email" label="Email" is-required></moul-text-field>
  <moul-button type="submit">Sign up</moul-button>
</moul-form>
```

### Overlays & Navigation

- [Modal](/docs/components/modal): Native `<dialog>` modal with focus trap and backdrop dismiss. Elements: `<moul-modal>`.

```html
<moul-modal id="invite" size="md">
  <h2 slot="header">Invite teammates</h2>
  <p>Send an invite link to your team.</p>
  <moul-button slot="footer" variant="primary">Send</moul-button>
</moul-modal>
```

```js
document.querySelector('#invite').isOpen = true
```

- [AlertDialog](/docs/components/alertdialog): Blocking confirmation dialog with `role="alertdialog"` and confirm/cancel events. Elements: `<moul-alert-dialog>`.

```html
<moul-alert-dialog is-open tone="error">
  <span slot="header">Delete project?</span>
  <span slot="body">This action cannot be undone.</span>
</moul-alert-dialog>
```

- [Drawer](/docs/components/drawer): Edge-anchored panel built on native `<dialog>`. Elements: `<moul-drawer>`.

```html
<moul-drawer placement="right" size="md" is-open>
  <h2 slot="header">Filters</h2>
  <p>Drawer content</p>
</moul-drawer>
```

- [Popover](/docs/components/popover): Popover API + CSS anchor positioning with a slotted trigger. Elements: `<moul-popover>`.

```html
<moul-popover placement="bottom">
  <moul-button slot="trigger" variant="outline">Options</moul-button>
  <p>Popover content</p>
</moul-popover>
```

- [Tooltip](/docs/components/tooltip): Hover/focus tooltip wired with `aria-describedby`. Elements: `<moul-tooltip>`.

```html
<moul-tooltip content="Copy to clipboard" placement="top">
  <moul-button is-icon aria-label="Copy">⧉</moul-button>
</moul-tooltip>
```

- [CommandPalette](/docs/components/commandpalette): ⌘K command menu with grouped, filterable items. Elements: `<moul-command-palette>`.

```html
<moul-command-palette id="cmdk" shortcut="k"></moul-command-palette>
```

```js
const palette = document.querySelector('#cmdk')
palette.items = [
  { id: 'new', title: 'New project', group: 'Actions', shortcut: 'N' },
  { id: 'settings', title: 'Open settings', group: 'Navigation' },
]
palette.addEventListener('select', (e) => console.log(e.detail.item))
```

- [Tabs](/docs/components/tabs): Tablist with sliding indicator and roving tabindex; panels matched by `key`. Elements: `<moul-tabs>`, `<moul-tab>`, `<moul-tab-panel>`.

```html
<moul-tabs selected-key="overview" variant="line">
  <moul-tab slot="tab" key="overview">Overview</moul-tab>
  <moul-tab slot="tab" key="activity">Activity</moul-tab>
  <moul-tab-panel key="overview">Overview content</moul-tab-panel>
  <moul-tab-panel key="activity">Activity content</moul-tab-panel>
</moul-tabs>
```

- [Breadcrumbs](/docs/components/breadcrumbs): Breadcrumb trail with `aria-current` on the last item. Elements: `<moul-breadcrumbs>`, `<moul-breadcrumb-item>`.

```html
<moul-breadcrumbs separator="/">
  <moul-breadcrumb-item href="/">Home</moul-breadcrumb-item>
  <moul-breadcrumb-item href="/projects">Projects</moul-breadcrumb-item>
  <moul-breadcrumb-item is-current>Moul UI</moul-breadcrumb-item>
</moul-breadcrumbs>
```

- [Pagination](/docs/components/pagination): Page navigation with ellipsis truncation. Elements: `<moul-pagination>`.

```html
<moul-pagination total-pages="12" current-page="3" sibling-count="1"></moul-pagination>
```

- [Link](/docs/components/link): Anchor with variants and external-link handling. Elements: `<moul-link>`.

```html
<moul-link href="https://moul.dev" is-external>moul.dev</moul-link>
```

### Surfaces & Feedback

- [Alert](/docs/components/alert): Inline status message with semantic tone and dismiss action. Elements: `<moul-alert>`.

```html
<moul-alert tone="success" variant="flat" title="Deployed" is-dismissible>
  Your changes are live.
</moul-alert>
```

- [Card](/docs/components/card): Surface container with header, body, and footer regions. Elements: `<moul-card>`, `<moul-card-header>`, `<moul-card-body>`, `<moul-card-footer>`.

```html
<moul-card variant="bordered" is-interactive>
  <moul-card-header>Usage</moul-card-header>
  <moul-card-body>1,204 requests today</moul-card-body>
  <moul-card-footer><moul-link href="/usage">View details</moul-link></moul-card-footer>
</moul-card>
```

- [Badge](/docs/components/badge): Compact status chip or dot indicator. Elements: `<moul-badge>`.

```html
<moul-badge tone="success" variant="flat">Active</moul-badge>
<moul-badge tone="error" is-dot aria-label="Offline"></moul-badge>
```

- [Avatar](/docs/components/avatar): Image avatar with initials fallback, status dot, and grouping. Elements: `<moul-avatar>`, `<moul-avatar-group>`.

```html
<moul-avatar-group max="3" size="sm">
  <moul-avatar name="Sophearak Tha" src="/avatars/1.png" status="online"></moul-avatar>
  <moul-avatar name="Dara Kim"></moul-avatar>
</moul-avatar-group>
```

- [Typography](/docs/components/typography): Headings, body, caption, and code text styles. Elements: `<moul-typography>`.

```html
<moul-typography variant="h2">Dashboard</moul-typography>
<moul-typography variant="caption" tone="accent">Updated 2 minutes ago</moul-typography>
```

- [Kbd](/docs/components/kbd): Keyboard shortcut hint. Elements: `<moul-kbd>`.

```html
<moul-kbd keys="Meta+K"></moul-kbd>
```

- [Separator](/docs/components/separator): Horizontal or vertical divider with `role="separator"`. Elements: `<moul-separator>`.

```html
<moul-separator orientation="horizontal"></moul-separator>
```

- [Spinner](/docs/components/spinner): Indeterminate loading indicator with accessible label. Elements: `<moul-spinner>`.

```html
<moul-spinner size="sm" label="Loading projects"></moul-spinner>
```

- [Skeleton](/docs/components/skeleton): Loading placeholder in line, circle, or rect shapes. Elements: `<moul-skeleton>`.

```html
<moul-skeleton shape="line" width="12rem"></moul-skeleton>
<moul-skeleton shape="circle" width="2.5rem" height="2.5rem" variant="wave"></moul-skeleton>
```

- [ProgressBar](/docs/components/progressbar): Determinate or indeterminate progress with `role="progressbar"`. Elements: `<moul-progress-bar>`.

```html
<moul-progress-bar value="64" max="100" tone="primary" aria-label="Upload progress"></moul-progress-bar>
```

- [TagGroup](/docs/components/taggroup): Selectable and removable tags. Elements: `<moul-tag-group>`, `<moul-tag>`.

```html
<moul-tag-group label="Filters" selection-mode="multiple" is-removable>
  <moul-tag key="open" tone="success">Open</moul-tag>
  <moul-tag key="bug" tone="error">Bug</moul-tag>
</moul-tag-group>
```

- [Table](/docs/components/table): Data table with sortable columns, row selection, and loading/empty states. Elements: `<moul-table>`.

```html
<moul-table id="users" is-sortable is-selectable>
  <span slot="caption">Team members</span>
  <span slot="empty">No members yet</span>
</moul-table>
```

```js
const table = document.querySelector('#users')
table.columns = [
  { key: 'name', title: 'Name', sortable: true },
  { key: 'role', title: 'Role' },
]
table.data = [{ id: '1', name: 'Dara', role: 'Admin' }]
```

- [Toast](/docs/components/toast): Transient notifications managed by the `toastQueue` singleton. Elements: `<moul-toast>`, `<moul-toast-region>`.

```html
<moul-toast-region></moul-toast-region>
<moul-toast tone="success" title="Saved" description="Your profile was updated."></moul-toast>
```

```js
import { toastQueue } from '@moul-dev/ui'

toastQueue.add({ title: 'Saved', description: 'Your profile was updated.', tone: 'success' })
```

- [EmptyState](/docs/components/emptystate): Placeholder for empty collections with icon and actions. Elements: `<moul-empty-state>`.

```html
<moul-empty-state size="md" align="center">
  <span slot="title">No projects</span>
  <span slot="description">Create your first project to get started.</span>
  <moul-button slot="actions" variant="primary">New project</moul-button>
</moul-empty-state>
```

### Composite Blocks

- [LogsViewer](/docs/blocks/logs): Virtualized log viewer with level filtering, search, and an inspector panel. Elements: `<moul-logs-viewer>`, `<moul-logs>`.

```html
<moul-logs-viewer id="viewer" title="Build logs" filter-level="all" max-height="480px"></moul-logs-viewer>

<moul-logs show-timestamps wrap-lines>
2026-10-19T10:00:01Z INFO server started on :8080
2026-10-19T10:00:04Z WARN cache miss ratio 0.42
</moul-logs>
```

```js
document.querySelector('#viewer').logs = [
  { id: 1, timestamp: '2026-10-19T10:00:01Z', level: 'info', message: 'server started' },
]
```

- [Sidebar](/docs/blocks/sidebar): Application shell with collapsible navigation, propagated via `@lit/context`. Elements: `<moul-sidebar>`, `<moul-sidebar-aside>`, `<moul-sidebar-header>`, `<moul-sidebar-brand>`, `<moul-sidebar-group>`, `<moul-sidebar-item>`, `<moul-sidebar-divider>`, `<moul-sidebar-footer>`, `<moul-sidebar-user>`, `<moul-sidebar-main>`.

```html
<moul-sidebar layout="sidebar-framed" selected-key="home">
  <moul-sidebar-aside aria-label="Main navigation" show-collapse-toggle>
    <moul-sidebar-header>
      <moul-sidebar-brand title="Moul" subtitle="Workspace" href="/"></moul-sidebar-brand>
    </moul-sidebar-header>
    <moul-sidebar-group label="General">
      <moul-sidebar-item key="home" href="/" label="Home"></moul-sidebar-item>
      <moul-sidebar-item key="inbox" href="/inbox" label="Inbox" badge="3"></moul-sidebar-item>
    </moul-sidebar-group>
    <moul-sidebar-divider></moul-sidebar-divider>
    <moul-sidebar-footer>
      <moul-sidebar-user name="Sophearak Tha" email="hello@moul.dev"></moul-sidebar-user>
    </moul-sidebar-footer>
  </moul-sidebar-aside>
  <moul-sidebar-main>Page content</moul-sidebar-main>
</moul-sidebar>
```
